note: REPORT ONLY — SITL egress NED vs planned setpoint ref; complements trk_err (GCS belief vs plan). Not scored by VALID/DAMAGE.

metric_definitions.tracking_error_truth_m: ||pos_SITL_egress − pos_planned|| (m) at each setpoint generation; truth = latest c2_telemetry_uav NED with t_uav ≤ t_generation_gcs. Compare to flight_state.tracking_error_m (trk_err = GCS belief vs plan).
metric_definitions.steady_tracking_error_truth_m: Same as tracking_error_truth_m restricted to trajectory_window=steady.
